findings.evidence: The only open-mapping invocation is line 106, `Φ.isQuotientMap hsurj`; Mathlib's `ContinuousLinearMap.isQuotientMap` in `Analysis/Normed/Operator/Banach.lean:250` assumes only `CompleteSpace` on its domain. Here that domain is `E × N`, completed using `CompleteSpace E` and `FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 N`; no step uses completeness of `F`.
findings.fix: Remove `[CompleteSpace F]` from the shared variables, retaining `[CompleteSpace E]` and `[CompleteSpace 𝕜]`.
findings.issue: The global `[CompleteSpace F]` assumption is unused and over-specializes `isClosed_range_of_finiteDimensional_coker`, `IsFredholm.of_finiteDimensional_ker_coker`, and `isFredholm_iff_finiteDimensional_ker_coker`.

summary: All three declarations unnecessarily require the codomain `F` to be complete; the argument only needs completeness of the source and scalar field.
